snippet.title: Watch Me Jump: Available Now
snippet.description:
Watch Me Jump is the first game from playwright Jeremy Gable. 

A different kind of basketball game, Watch Me Jump is a digital story of scandal and betrayal, played out in four quarters.

Watch Me Jump is out now for PC and Mac. To purchase:

Steam - http://store.steampowered.com/app/698770/Watch_Me_Jump/
Game Jolt - https://jeremygable.gamejolt.io/watchmejump
itch.io - https://jeremygable.itch.io/watchmejump
